results.content:
The Blessing of the Welkin Moon, or Welkin Moon, is a subscription that you can pay for in Genshin Impact in order to receive 90 Primogems every day for 30 days. Since this does require some real-world money, it’s important to consider the pros and cons before paying for it. Whether you purchase this or not depends entirely on how much you play and what kind of person you are.

Recommended Videos

## Why you should get the Welkin Moon in Genshin Impact [...] For starters, the Welkin Moon costs $4.99 and the maximum amount of Primogems you can get is 3000. You receive a total of 2700 from the daily Primogems, as well as 300 Genesis Crystals after you make the purchase. 3000 Primogems equates to around 20 pulls. That’s not too bad, considering that hard pity for a character is 90 pulls. [...] As a note, it costs $49.99 to get 3280 Genesis Crystals in the store. That’s not including the first-time purchase bonus. You can get the 3000 all at once, of course. But it costs significantly more to receive the same amount of in-game currency as the Welkin Moon. If you log in every day, plan on playing Genshin Impact seriously, and can spare the money, then the Welkin Moon is a great investment.
